text: D01 pilot evidence refines the next derivative isolation. TrueCcSession multiplies CC intensity derivatives by central physical differences of already-warped images; the actual perturbation instead composes midpoint residuals and samples the original prepared images through fused affine/grid interpolation. Next diagnostic should compare (1) the existing production velocity-gradient dot direction, (2) CC intensity-gradient dot the actual plus/minus warped-image difference, and (3) the frozen-objective finite difference at the same declared epsilon sequence. Agreement of (2) and (3) with disagreement of (1) would localize the observed 4–15% derivative errors to the spatial/composition chain; disagreement of (2) and (3) would keep CC differentiation/support in scope. This is a falsifiable proposed isolation, not a confirmed defect. Separately, the committed OASIS 11 step-scaled trajectory improves the independent fixed intensity audit while losing Dice during fine refinement, so corrected differentiation alone is not yet an anatomical remedy. D01 remains open and D02 is not claimed complete.
